name: NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint
description: NVIDIA's deep-research agent blueprint that searches the web and enterprise knowledge sources to write cited reports.
whatItDoes: AI-Q answers quick questions or runs longer research jobs over web search providers, paper search and private document collections. It is a reference for enterprises building research assistants on NVIDIA models.
howItWorks: Built on the NeMo Agent Toolkit, it routes a query to a shallow or deep researcher, with pluggable data-source packages and CLI, API and web frontends. It can be run from a virtual environment or with Docker Compose.
